knowledge.name: Synthetic Product Catalog
knowledge.detail: Eight packaged SKUs provide product, brand, price, rating, style tags, colors, sizes, and size-level stock snapshots.

knowledge.name: Opt-In Shopper Profiles
knowledge.detail: Two synthetic profiles contain only stated sizing, style, brand, color, budget, and prior-product examples.

knowledge.name: Fixed Outfit Templates
knowledge.detail: Business Casual, Weekend Smart, Active Weekend, and Evening Out define the supported coordinated looks.

knowledge.name: Shopping Rules and Safety
knowledge.detail: Uploaded guidance limits responses to explainable drafts and prohibits sensitive inference or external side effects.

intelligence_processing.name: Explainable Preference Matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Scores catalog items from stated style, brand, color, and budget signals without deriving sensitive traits.

intelligence_processing.name: Ranked Product Drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Excludes prior products, ranks remaining items by match score, and presents price, brand, rating, and tradeoffs.

intelligence_processing.name: Profile Summary Generation
intelligence_processing.detail: Formats stated shopper sizing and preferences for clienteling continuity without adding inferred attributes.

intelligence_processing.name: Availability Classification
intelligence_processing.detail: Reports synthetic quantity by size and labels each entry In Stock, Low Stock, or Out of Stock.

intelligence_processing.name: Coordinated Outfit Assembly
intelligence_processing.detail: Selects the best matching catalog piece for each fixed template slot and calculates an illustrative total.

clients_user_interface.name: Personal Shopper View
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents occasion-ready product and outfit options with transparent match rationale, prices, and tradeoffs.

clients_user_interface.name: Clienteling Specialist View
clients_user_interface.detail: Surfaces opt-in preference summaries for continuity and respectful follow-up drafting.

clients_user_interface.name: Retail Manager View
clients_user_interface.detail: Shows size-level inventory snapshots, availability caveats, and service-quality context.

clients_user_interface.name: Brainstem and Studio Chat
clients_user_interface.detail: The portable agent runs in Brainstem chat and has passed four draft Copilot Studio preview cases.

management_reporting.name: Recommendation Evidence Table
management_reporting.detail: Ranks draft products with SKU, brand, price, match score, and rating for transparent review.

management_reporting.name: Inventory Snapshot Report
management_reporting.detail: Lists stock by size, status, and total units while requiring verification before any operational use.

management_reporting.name: Outfit Cost Summary
management_reporting.detail: Breaks each coordinated look into selected pieces and an illustrative total without ordering items.

management_reporting.name: Safety and Verification Notice
management_reporting.detail: Every operation states the synthetic scope and confirms that no inventory, benefit, order, return, refund, or purchase changed.

tools.name: Product Recommendations
tools.detail: Routes transparent product-option requests to the product_recommendations operation.

tools.name: Style Profile
tools.detail: Routes stated-preference summaries to the style_profile operation.

tools.name: Inventory Check
tools.detail: Routes SKU or catalog availability requests to the read-only inventory_check operation.

tools.name: Outfit Builder
tools.detail: Routes coordinated-look and outfit-total requests to the review-only outfit_builder operation.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-Only Data Boundary
supporting_features.detail: The package accepts its fixed synthetic records only and rejects any non-synthetic data_source value.

supporting_features.name: Recommendation-Only Safety
supporting_features.detail: The agent never reserves stock, applies benefits, creates orders, processes returns or refunds, or completes purchases.

supporting_features.name: Sensitive-Inference Guardrail
supporting_features.detail: Instructions prohibit inferring body, health, identity, wealth, eligibility, or other sensitive traits.

supporting_features.name: Persona-Aware Responses
supporting_features.detail: Approved roles are Personal Shopper, Clienteling Specialist, and Retail Manager, each with an explicit focus.

supporting_features.name: Human Review and Verification
supporting_features.detail: All recommendations and totals are drafts, and inventory must be verified before operational use.

supporting_features.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6 Preview
supporting_features.detail: The draft Copilot Studio pilot was validated with Claude Sonnet 4.6 across all four canonical preview cases.
